2607.08357.title: MobiDiff: Semantic-Aware Multi-Channel Discrete Diffusion for Human Mobility Data Generation
2607.08357.paper_summary: Human mobility data are essential for transportation optimization, urban planning, and resource allocation, yet real-world mobility data are costly to collect and difficult to share due to privacy concerns. Recent diffusion-based methods have shown promise in synthesizing realistic mobility patterns, but they typically rely on continuous or latent spatio-temporal traces, limiting their ability to natively model discrete semantic events with explicit region, activity, time, and interval structures. To address this issue, we introduce MobiDiff, an end-to-end discrete diffusion framework that efficiently generates mobility data by directly denoising multi-channel semantic skeletons, avoiding the costly interpolation, latent trace construction, and coarse-to-fine realization pipelines widely used in existing diffusion-based methods. Specifically, MobiDiff decomposes each human check-in event into spatial, activity, and temporal channels, and employs structured event-, group-, and channel-level masking to jointly capture trajectory-level mobility patterns and within-event dependencies. We evaluate generation fidelity, privacy-preserving, and efficiency on three large-scale real-world datasets from Atlanta, Boston, and Seattle. Results show that MobiDiff effectively preserves trajectory length and temporal interval distributions while remaining competitive across broader mobility statistics; it is also much faster than state-of-the-art methods, e.g., 5.3$\times$ faster than GeoGen on average during inference. These findings suggest that discrete diffusion offers an interpretable and efficient framework for synthetic mobility data generation.
2607.08357.paper_summary_zh: 人類移動數據對於交通優化、城市規劃和資源配置至關重要，但由於隱私問題，現實世界的移動數據收集成本高且難以共享。最近的基於擴散的方法在合成現實移動模式方面顯示出潛力，但它們通常依賴於連續或潛在的時空痕跡，限制了它們原生建模具有明確區域、活動、時間和間隔結構的離散語義事件的能力。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了MobiDiff，一個端到端的離散擴散框架，通過直接去噪多通道語義骨架來高效生成移動數據，避免了現有基於擴散的方法中廣泛使用的成本高昂的插值、潛在痕跡構建和粗到細的實現管道。具體而言，MobiDiff將每個人類登錄事件分解為空間、活動和時間通道，並採用結構化的事件、群組和通道級別的遮罩來共同捕捉軌跡級別的移動模式和事件內依賴性。我們在來自亞特蘭大、波士頓和西雅圖的三個大型現實世界數據集上評估生成的真實性、隱私保護和效率。結果顯示，MobiDiff有效地保留了軌跡長度和時間間隔分佈，同時在更廣泛的移動統計數據中保持競爭力；它的速度也比最先進的方法快得多，例如，在推理過程中平均比GeoGen快5.3$\times$。這些發現表明，離散擴散提供了一個可解釋和高效的合成移動數據生成框架。
